title: Holes in Valid-Extension Sets of Finite Gilbreath Sequences
summary: Given a finite sequence of integers, form its difference triangle by repeatedly taking absolute differences of consecutive entries. We call the sequence Gilbreath if the leftmost entry of every row below the top is 1. The Gilbreath conjecture, which remains open, asserts that every initial segment of the primes is a Gilbreath sequence. This paper studies the local extension problem: given a Gilbreath sequence, which integers can be appended to it while preserving the Gilbreath property?
